method: Separate source-first pass by the same AI operator; no second human reviewer is claimed. Re-read adopted OER and live course descriptions, then tested each final programme claim and alignment against actual workbook content rather than treating the implementation rationale as authority.

interests.conclusion: Formal route distinctions, support-only Arabic, source/cohort qualifications and outcome attribution checked against current evidence. No historical career narrative is treated as a promised professional qualification.

construction.conclusion: One defensible broader response, not a specialist theology or comparative-religion degree. Thirteen philosophy/literary/heritage courses provide a defining meaning/myth/interpretation centre; social-belief, institutions and research courses make concrete complementary contributions. Specialist confessional/Islamic/ministerial sequences are not supplied.
sourceChallengesResolved: Re-read philosophy emotion, mind and free-will profiles: concrete meaning/self/ethics contribution, not attributed theology teaching.
Re-read myth and VU World Philosophy pages: two partial content relationships only; Western philosophy does not replace the VU world-philosophy breadth.
VU Social Sciences explicitly concerns sociology/psychology/pedagogy of religion. Generic UCR qualitative research is not substituted; retained blank.
Social psychology and social theory provide belief/identity/public-life perspectives, not Psychology of Religion equivalence.
Heritage/art courses contribute interpretation of cultural artefacts and social values; no claim that they reproduce sacred-text interpretation or sustained religious traditions.
Formal legal prerequisite and all offerings independently recomputed. Advisory progression reviewed; advanced sociology follows introductory and modern sociology.

audience: Actual desktop/mobile text contains reviewed route/pace, broader concept and specialist/professional limitations; no internal sourceNotes, traceability or component bookkeeping selected. No awaiting-review text.
limitations: External destination pages were retrieved independently over HTTP 200. Browser tests verify source hrefs; external destination rendering is not certified.
